tests/packet_shape_integrity.test.js also defines a second, separate function fnv1aHashBytes(buffer) implementing FNV-1a 64-bit over a raw byte buffer using BigInt, with the same offset-basis 0xcbf29ce484222325 and prime 0x100000001b3, masked to 64 bits and returned as a 16-char hex string.

tests/m0_trust_semantics.test.js defines its own function fnv1aHashBytes(buffer) implementing FNV-1a 64-bit over a byte buffer using BigInt, with offset-basis 0xcbf29ce484222325 and prime 0x100000001b3, masked to 64 bits and returned as a 16-char hex string, identical in body to the other JS implementations.

mythos-compiler/src/compiler/run_dir.rs defines fn fnv1a_hash(bytes: &[u8]) -> String implementing FNV-1a 64-bit in Rust using native u64 arithmetic, with offset-basis 0xcbf29ce484222325u64 and prime 0x100000001b3 applied via wrapping_mul, formatted as a 16-char lowercase hex string.

There are 9 FNV-1a 64-bit hash implementations in this repository (8 JavaScript: driver.mjs, scripts/strict-gate.mjs, scripts/readiness.mjs, scripts/ingest-subagent.mjs, two module-level plus one nested in tests/packet_shape_integrity.test.js, and one in tests/m0_trust_semantics.test.js; 1 Rust: mythos-compiler/src/compiler/run_dir.rs), and all 9 use the identical offset-basis 0xcbf29ce484222325 and prime 0x100000001b3, so their constants agree.

Re-checked all 10 evidence records (9 implementation claims + 1 aggregate) against cited file:line ranges and constants, all matched; an independent repo-wide sweep for 0xcbf29ce484222325 and a decimal/pattern cross-check found the same 7 files and no missed implementation.
Captured quarantined subagent output for lane critic-audit; machine records were extracted without Prime synthesis.

ev-map-10 in evidence-map.md asserts a repo-wide claim ('all 9 [implementations] use the identical offset-basis ... so their constants agree') but cites only one file's 8-line span, the same span ev-map-9 already used to support a single-implementation claim — an aggregate 9-way agreement claim should not rest on a citation into just one of the nine implementations.

MYTHOS-ENGINE-PLAN.md already names this exact fnv1a duplication as unresolved architecture debt (F5: 'fnv1a is implemented four times ... the empirical case for one engine in one language') and schedules a fix ('one hash module; BLAKE3 for receipts, fnv1a accepted read-only for legacy refs'), yet evidence-map.md never cites or cross-references that plan, presenting the 9 duplicates as neutral inventory rather than flagging that consolidation was already committed to and has not happened.

The plan document's own citation for the Rust fnv1a implementation (run_dir.rs:546) is now stale — line 546 of the current file is an unrelated direct-source-id membership check, not fnv1a_hash (now at line 682) — meaning nobody updated the duplication tracking as the file grew, and the true count has silently risen from the plan's stated four implementations to the nine evidence-map.md found (readiness.mjs plus three separate definitions across two test files), so the debt is proliferating rather than being paid down.

Three subagent lanes mapped and verified 8 FNV-1a 64-bit implementations (4 source: scripts/ingest-subagent.mjs, scripts/strict-gate.mjs, driver.mjs, mythos-compiler/src/compiler/run_dir.rs; 4 test copies), all sharing offset 0xcbf29ce484222325 and prime 0x100000001b3 per vf-verify-ev-map-1..8; aggregate claims ev-map-9/10 stayed unpromoted due to auto-contradictions with the critic lane; critic flags 8x duplication as consolidation risk (M3 one-binary milestone).
